content.bridge_context: Understanding that science is a process of discovery and constant change.

units.title: What is Science?
units.explanation: Science is a systematic way of learning about the world through observation and experimentation.
units.dual_language_instruction: Observe one thing in your kitchen today. / आज अपनी रसोई में एक चीज़ का अवलोकन करें।

units.title: Scientific Method
units.dual_language_instruction: List the steps of an experiment. / किसी प्रयोग के चरणों की सूची बनाएं।
